# The move alone does not fix the outcome

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`the-move-alone-underdetermines` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](the-move-alone-underdetermines.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Where a step by a move has situations reaching two different configurations, the finer law takes both by the same move, and no law giving the next configuration from the configuration and the move alone is right on both.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. With positive weight on two different targets of one move from one configuration, the finer law has a step to each, and no map from configuration and move to the next configuration gives both. (`Becoming.Situations.move_underdetermines`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom; natural-number weights of situations.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- Which situation obtains, or that any actual move has two.
